summary: The FFLA Texas index lists a gone tower at Humble, Harris County. No other source found describes a lookout there.

facts.status_note: FFLA lists it as gone. No source gives a removal date or describes the site today.

evidence.supports: Listed as a tower in Harris County with status Gone

notes_for_editor: No story written. The only source is the FFLA index row. Two web searches and reads of the Texas Escapes Humble town history, the Wikipedia list of fire lookout towers and the Cavallerano book page found no lookout at Humble. The Texas Escapes page has a photo captioned as the Humble water tower, the only tower in that material. The FFLA row might be a different structure, but no source says so. The FFLA point is about 1.2 km north of the town coordinates on that page. Hold for a Texas A&M Forest Service or Harris County source, or for editor approval of a short stub.
